name: Rubble & Crew
description: Follow Rubble and his pup family as they use their awesome construction vehicles to build and repair whatever the town of Builder Cove needs in high-stakes adventures.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Bridge
videos.overview: Rubble and his construction pup family gear up to build a bridge, only to find the villainous Speed Meister has a different idea. It's up to the Rubble & Crew to work together and save the day by building a new, safe bridge to Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Big Bike Shop
videos.overview: Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival... unless Speed Meister beats them to it!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Super Tub
videos.overview: When Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Ice Cream Shop
videos.overview: When a windy day derails construction on an ice cream shop, Rubble & Crew are on the chase.

videos.title: The Crew Fixes a Squeak
videos.overview: There's a mysterious squeak in City Hall. Mayor Greatway asks Rubble and Charger to find and fix the squeak before her big speech!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Playground
videos.overview: After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, Rubble & Crew get creative and build a whole new one with old materials.

videos.title: The Crew Fixes a Roof
videos.overview: The town Chili Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in! Luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Car Wash
videos.overview: Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast! Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race.

videos.title: The Crew Plans Grandpa Day
videos.overview: It's Grandpa Gravel's special day! But when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Skate Park
videos.overview: The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboard star! But while building a surprise skatepark, they have to fix a cement mix mishap.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Tunnel
videos.overview: Charger's favorite singer Sierra Sparkle is coming to town... if the pups can build a tunnel for her tour bus!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Beaver Home
videos.overview: The power is out in Builder Cove! When the pups find out a beaver is to blame, they've got to build him a new home to bring the power back.

videos.title: The Crew Fixes a Road
videos.overview: When Speed Meister damages the road ahead of the town helper parade, the pups work fast to repave the way.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Popcorn Café
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew switch to cleanup mode when construction on Café Carl's new popcorn restaurant pops out of control.

videos.title: The Crew Fixes a Slippery Mess
videos.overview: A soapy accident causes slippery mayhem all over Builder Cove. Can the pups clean it up in time for Mayor Greatway's big jump?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Drive-In Movie Theater
videos.overview: Mix and Motor's favorite TV star has a new movie playing in Builder Cove. The pups need to build a movie theater to watch it!

videos.title: The Crew Finds a Rainbow Treasure
videos.overview: Grandpa tells the pups about a secret buried treasure, they find out the key to finding this treasure is construction teamwork!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Pig Barn
videos.overview: A new farmer in town asks Rubble & Crew to build a barn for her pig! But will it be done in time for the big Pig Party?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Runway
videos.overview: Motor's super special birthday present gets delayed when the pups realize Builder Cove's airport needs a bigger runway.

videos.title: The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Station
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall! But when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

videos.title: The Crew Does a Home Renovation
videos.overview: Mix and Rubble are starstruck when their favorite TV renovation star, Hank Hammer, comes to see them at work.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Lighthouse
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot brings Mayor Goodway to visit her sister, Mayor Greatway. But when a thick fog rolls in, the pups have to build a lighthouse fast!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Dinosaur Museum
videos.overview: After uncovering dinosaur bones, the pups decide to build a museum! But when there are more dinos than expected, the pups need to think fast.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Wheelchair Ramp
videos.overview: When Omar the Mail Carrier breaks his foot, it's up to the pups to make sure he can still deliver the mail.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Splash Park
videos.overview: With their splash park plans in troubled waters, the pups have to get creative to cool down the town for the summer.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Playroom
videos.overview: As the pups work on building a surprise playroom for Lucas and Lily, a squirrelly visitor causes

videos.title: The Crew Builds a School
videos.overview: It’s the first day of school in Builder Cove… if Rubble & Crew can finish building the school in time!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Waterway
videos.overview: The pups need a construction solution to save Farmer Zoe’s crops and to keep Crunchy the beaver from taking all the water!

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Observatory
videos.overview: The pups jump into action to build an observatory to help their friend River get a cool picture of a shooting star!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Zipline
videos.overview: After meeting Park Ranger Rose, the pups get stuck on a nature trail! But with Rubble & Crew, there's always a construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Library Tea Shop
videos.overview: Construction on the first Builder Cove library is abuzz with bees! This calls for an extra sweet construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Dance Floor
videos.overview: Grandpa Gravel teaches Charger all his best moves for the big dance contest, but will a runaway disco ball cost them first place?

videos.title: The Crew Fixes a Haunted House
videos.overview: When Mayor Greatway asks the pups to fix up a house for her Halloween party, they find out this house might be haunted!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Bat House
videos.overview: When Rubble & Crew discover some batty visitors at their Fall Festival, the pups must work fast to build the bats a new, safe home.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Christmas Show
videos.overview: Happy Holidays from Rubble and Crew and Truffles the pig, stars of Builder Cove's first ever Christmas Show... on ice!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Sled Ramp
videos.overview: When their winter day is snow-free, Rubble and Crew work together to make all of Lucas & Lily's snow sledding dreams come true.

videos.title: The Crew and Chase are On The Case
videos.overview: There's a mystery afoot in Builder Cove! When the sculpture of all the townsfolk suddenly disappears, Chase joins Rubble and Crew to solve the case of the missing statue... and build a brand new Science Center to help investigate.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Lemonade Stand
videos.overview: After the Crew builds a special lemonade stand for Lucas and Lily, a sour Speed Meister sends it rolling through Builder Cove!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Wildlife Bridge
videos.overview: Why does Crunchy the beaver cross the road? Because Rubble and Crew build a bridge to help him get to the other side!

videos.title: The Crew Fixes The Talent Show Stage
videos.overview: When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town Talent Show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day.

videos.title: The Crew Builds Instruments
videos.overview: Sierra Sparkle is coming to sing for Builder Cove Day! But when the band's instruments break, Rubble and Crew have a construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Dam
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rain storm threatens to flood the town.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Squirrel-Proof Farm
videos.overview: Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Fountain Show
videos.overview: When Sierra Sparkle's big concert stage needs some extra sparkle, Rubble & Crew use a construction complication to make a big splash.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Carousel
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew decide to go big when Grocer Gabriel wants something special built outside of his grocery store.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Parking Garage
videos.overview: Café Carl's brand new ice cream machine brings lots of cars to Builder Cove... with nowhere to park!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Campsite
videos.overview: When Rubble's fear of the dark derails the pup's Bark Yard campout, the crew comes up with a bright idea to help Rubble enjoy the starry night.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Treehouse
videos.overview: Park Ranger Rose's tree might be off limits for climbing, unless Rubble and Grandpa can come up with a solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Chicken Feeder
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew are building a feeder for Farmer Zoe's chickens, but when they get loose, it's up to the pups to wrangle their fowl friends.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Roller Coaster
videos.overview: When Speed Meister's roller coaster sends a pet playdate out of control, Rubble and Crew save the day with a bigger, better, and safer coaster.

videos.title: The Crew Builds Motor a Play Space
videos.overview: The Bark Yard safety inspection is today! But will Motor go boom and cost the Crew a gold safety star?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Train Station
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoe's new cow Mooreen.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Sign
videos.overview: Popstar Sierra Sparkle is moving to Builder Cove! But when the pups plan a surprise greeting, Speed Meister makes a plan of his own.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Mini Golf Course
videos.overview: When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble & Crew use their construction skills to build a new sport... Bunny Ball!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Butterfly Garden
videos.overview: After the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away! Will a giant butterfly garden help bring it back?

videos.title: The Crew Builds Library Treasure Tunnels
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew's favorite book series has new additions! But when there's no room for them in the library, the pups have to get creative.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Super Snack Dispenser
videos.overview: The pups have a surprise just for Rubble - a snack dispenser! But will they finish it before Rubble finds out?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Hair Salon
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew build a hair salon just in time for Grandpa Gravel's special photo—until they run into a squirrely shampoo setback!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Colorful Crystal Show
videos.overview: Motor and Lily make a shiny discovery worth celebrating with the coolest light show the pups have ever seen!

videos.title: The Crew & Skye Build a Mountain Lodge
videos.overview: Skye visits Rubble and his crew from Adventure Bay when their construction project needs some aerial support. When Speed Meister tries to beat the pups to finish the job, Skye, Rubble and the rest of the crew jump into rescue mode to save the day.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Gym
videos.overview: Coach Karima asks Rubble and Crew to build a gym for the gymnastics show but when the beam is too high for Lily, the pups must save the day.

videos.title: The Crew Puts on a Construction Show
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew decide to build a show on their own when a traveling show can't get to Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds Charger a Super Bed
videos.overview: Charger has got too much energy to sleep; Rubble and Crew knows there's always a construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Super Squirrelly Whirly Playground
videos.overview: Rubble and the pups build Mix, Motor, Lucas, and Lily a Super Squirrelly Whirly playdate.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Smoothie Shop
videos.overview: Café Carl opens up a smoothie shop on the boardwalk! But when the coaster causes coconut chaos, Rubble & Crew know just what to do.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Dino Roof Party
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew work together to find a construction solution when Charger's bouncy birthday surprise needs a lift.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Ferris Wheel
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew want to give Grocer Gabriel the best beach day ever, including a ride on a brand new Ferris wheel at the boardwalk.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Yoga Space
videos.overview: When Farmer Zoe's animals need some relaxation, the pups build a perfect place to practice yoga with Coach Karima.

videos.title: The Crew Builds Mr. Ducky-Doo a Special Diving Board
videos.overview: Mayor Greatway asks Rubble & Crew to build something special for her friend Mr. Ducky Doo.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Rainwater Tank
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew work to build a rain tank for Farmer Zoe before a storm, until a chicken complication crops up.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Reuse-It Station
videos.overview: When Speed Meister builds his own station for reusing trash, the pups have to clean up the mess all over Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Duck Bridge
videos.overview: After a baby duckling follows them home, Rubble & Crew use their construction know-how to bring the duckling back to its home.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Ballpark
videos.overview: When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can’t get out of town to participate in a home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a ballpark to hold the derby right in Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Surf Bridge
videos.overview: Surf's up for Rubble & Crew! Well, if they can get over the super hot sand, it is.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Pizza Parlor
videos.overview: Mayor Greatway needs a lot of pizzas; when Speed Meister helps, the pups have to fix his pizza problem.

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Airport Road
videos.overview: When a family can't get to the airport in time on Speed Meister's road, Rubble & Crew has to build a new road before takeoff.

videos.title: The Crew Celebrates Builder Covegiving Day
videos.overview: After Speed Meister sabotages Family, Friends & Fun Day, it's up to the pups to save the holiday for everyone in Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Rocket Ship Ride
videos.overview: Mix dreams about giving the moon a Mix makeover. Rubble and the pups make her dream a reality with a new boardwalk ride!

videos.title: The Crew Raises a Runway
videos.overview: When Buttons the deer needs to cross the Builder Cove airport's runway, Rubble & Crew know just what to build.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Skateboard
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew build a supersized skateboard for Auntie Crane and River's show. But when it rolls out of control, the pups lead the chase!

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Indoor Skydiving Center
videos.overview: Mayor Greatway and Mr. Ducky Doo want to show their skydiving skills. But when wind gets in the way, the pups help them sky dive on the ground!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Roller Rink
videos.overview: When Wheeler and Truffles the pig can't ice skate, the crew finds a construction solution... with wheels!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Bowling Alley
videos.overview: Rubble & the pups find Grandpa Gravel's lucky bowling ball. Too bad Builder Cove doesn't have a bowling alley... until now!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Superbloom Path
videos.overview: When a sudden superbloom traps Motor, Lily, and Park Ranger Rose, the pups need a flower-friendly construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Makes Christmas Magical
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve and Rubble and his crew get a call from Santa Claus — he needs help to build all the toys in time for Christmas! But, when Speed Meister overhears and tries to be the construction hero, Rubble and the pups have to save Christmas.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Winter Wonderland
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew are transforming Builder Cove's beach boardwalk into a festive winter wonderland.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Snow Squirrelly Whirly
videos.overview: A snow day gets in the way of Motor & Mix's Super Squirrelly Whirly plans.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Post Office
videos.overview: Builder Cove needs a post office and construction gets squirrely.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Wash
videos.overview: Converting the super car wash and cleaning Farmer Zoe's extra muddy animals.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Hotel
videos.overview: Builder Cove gets its first hotel when Farmer Zoe's brother Hadley comes to visit; Hadley may or may not approve of the new hotel.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Hiking Trail
videos.overview: After a hiking trail sign mix-up confuses everyone going to Mr. Ducky-Doo's birthday party, Rubble and Crew help them get back on track.

videos.title: The Crew & Rocky Build a Bear Island
videos.overview: Rocky leaves Adventure Bay to visit Rubble and his family–just in time to see Builder Cove's new baby bear. When Park Ranger Rose asks for construction help, Speed Meister accidentally ruins the bears' home, leaving it up to the pups and Rocky to save the day.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Kangaroo Safari
videos.overview: Rubble and crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the bark yard until their construction kangaroo hops away.

videos.title: The Crew Plays in the Construction Games
videos.overview: Speed Meister challenges Rubble and crew to compete in the ultimate build-off, Builder Cove's first construction games.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Rooftop Stage
videos.overview: When Grocer Gabriel and Sierra Sparkle both need construction help before Banana Day, Rubble & Crew have their paws full.

videos.title: The Crew Fixes the Lighthouse
videos.overview: Speed Meister shines his face in the sky with the lighthouse; the pups jump into action.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Solar-Powered Bus
videos.overview: When Speed Meister steals Rubble and Crew's bus, the pups have to stop it in time for Sierra Sparkle's concert!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Lifeguard Tower
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew build a lifeguard tower so the beach can open in Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Vet Clinic
videos.overview: When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble and Crew know what to do.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Mermaid Party
videos.overview: Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain; time for a construction solution!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Sea Wall
videos.overview: Park Ranger Rose asks Rubble and crew to fix the bridge to Bear Island; but when Speed Meister intervenes, the pups must clean up his mess and protect the bears from a rapidly approaching storm with help from Auntie Crane's new Bark Yard Zoomer!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Hotel Elevator
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew helps at Hotel Hadley after snow and when stairs fail, it's bow wow time.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Popcorn-Cat Café
videos.overview: Café Carl adopted kittens! But when they cause popcorn pandemonium, Rubble & Crew make the café cat-friendly.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Super Mega Movie Screen
videos.overview: A new Super Squirrelly Whirly movie is playing at the drive-in theater! But when Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action to save the day.

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Auntie Day Present
videos.overview: It's Auntie Day! But can the pups finish building their present for Auntie Crane in time?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Skate Track
videos.overview: Rubble and crew help River take lots of pictures for the big photo contest by building a super-fast way to get around Builder Cove.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Ice Cream Maker
videos.overview: Rubble and the pups help Café Carl make enough ice cream for everyone! If Speed Meister doesn't get in the way....

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Skyscraper
videos.overview: Rubble and crew are building their biggest construction project ever, a skyscraper; and a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles; but when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother.

videos.title: The Crew Lifts Up City Hall
videos.overview: A herd of bison are migrating through Builder Cove-right toward City Hall.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Rotating Restaurant
videos.overview: Rubble and crew hop in their big vehicles to save the day; the pups use their mega-sized trucks to help Lucas and Lily give their parents an awesome anniversary.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Tunnel
videos.overview: Park Ranger Rose and the crew discover a meteorite outside of Builder Cove; when Speed Meister and Mega Meister try to take it, the pups need their construction vehicles to save the town and get the meteorite to the Science Centre.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Mega Stunt Ramp
videos.overview: The crew uses their trucks to make stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Solar Farm
videos.overview: When power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show, the pups hop in their big vehicles to turn the power back on.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Turtle House
videos.overview: It's Friend Appreciation Day; but when Speed Meister's gift for Mr. McTurtle goes awry, he has to call Rubble and crew for help.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Volcano
videos.overview: Rubble and Crew helps Lucas make the Science Fair volcano; but will Wingsy get in the way of the eruption?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Firefighter Training Center
videos.overview: A new fire captain helps train the pups as firefighter recruits at the fire station.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Space Show
videos.overview: Charger is excited to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show, but a hurt paw stops him.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Halloween Maze
videos.overview: The crew builds a spooky maze for Halloween; when Omar and Romar get lost in the maze, the pups jump to the rescue.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Pup House
videos.overview: When a spooky movie keeps Rubble awake, the pups come up with a construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Santa's Village
videos.overview: Santa's coming to visit Builder Cove! But when Speed Meister tricks him into stopping at the wrong place, Rubble & Crew have to save Santa.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Dreidel
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew make Builder Cove's big Hanukkah celebration even bigger by building an awesome giant dreidel.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Duck Plane
videos.overview: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Special Vet Room for Motor
videos.overview: Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic so the pups build a special space just for her!

videos.title: The Crew Builds an Art Museum
videos.overview: Rubble & Crew build the perfect place to show off River's ever-changing photography projects... Builder Cove's own art museum!

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Giant Alphorn
videos.overview: Farmer Zoe has a new goat on her farm! But when she can't find the singing goat, the pups team up with Park Ranger Rose.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant
videos.overview: When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea. But is it too fancy?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Castle Show
videos.overview: Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show! But when Rosie disappears, can the pups find her before showtime?

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Pirate Ship Café
videos.overview: When Café Carl's pirate-themed restaurant gets caught in rough waters, the pups set sail with a new construction solution.

videos.title: The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Experience
videos.overview: Sierra Sparkle calls in help from Rubble & Crew to build a special experience for all her fans in Builder Cove.
